description.value:
You've learned to channel your connection to the Force to bolster a specific specialty. Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Choose one skill or tool in which you have proficiency. When making a check with it that doesn't already use your Wisdom or Charisma modifier, you may add half that modifier (your choice of ability, minimum 1). You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses after a long rest.

This feat can be taken multiple times, choosing a different skill or tool each time.
